newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil FDI at $200 mln in first week of April.
newsitem.headline: Brazil FDI at $200 mln in first week of April.

text.p: Foreign direct investment to Brazil was $200 million in the first week of April, said Altamir Lopes, head of the Central Bank's economics department.
"The latest figure I heard was $200 million," Lopes said, clarifying that that was the foreign direct investment (FDI) level in the first week of the month.
"That's not bad. It's at normal levels," he told reporters.
With first quarter 1997 direct investment at $2.9 billion, Lopes predicted that FDI for the whole year would exceed $12 billion, compared with $9.4 billion in 1996.
